title: Wrap the Fraud Model in a FastAPI REST API
objective: Save your trained model to disk and serve it through a FastAPI endpoint so any client can send a transaction and receive a fraud prediction — decoupling the model from the UI.
task_description:
Building on the fraud detection model from Day 1, create a production-style REST API using FastAPI:
1. Serialize your trained RandomForest model and any preprocessing objects (scaler, column list) to disk with joblib — save as fraud_model.pkl and fraud_artifacts.pkl.
2. Create api.py with a FastAPI app. Define a POST /predict endpoint that accepts a JSON body with the 28 V-features plus Amount, runs the model, and returns {prediction: 0|1, label: 'Legit'|'Fraud', confidence: float}.
3. Add a GET /health endpoint that returns {status: 'ok', model_loaded: true}.
4. Validate the request body with a Pydantic model — reject inputs with missing or non-numeric fields with a clear 422 error.
5. Test the endpoint manually with curl or the /docs Swagger UI.
expected_output: Running uvicorn api:app, POST /predict with valid feature values returns a JSON fraud prediction with a confidence score. GET /health returns 200. The /docs Swagger UI is accessible.
evaluation_criteria:
1. fraud_model.pkl and fraud_artifacts.pkl exist and load correctly.
2. POST /predict returns {prediction, label, confidence} for valid input.
3. POST /predict returns 422 for malformed input (missing fields, wrong types).
4. GET /health returns 200 with model_loaded: true.
5. The API runs without errors via uvicorn api:app.
unlock_condition: POST /predict returns a fraud prediction with confidence score and GET /health returns 200.
